svg.text: 1 Unread dot: 9px disc, left 12, top 18. fgColor-accent. Seen rows have none.
2 Title: 15/22, weight 600 unread, 400 read. fgColor-default. Clamp 2 lines.
3 NEW / UPDATED badge: 12/16, 700, padding 2 6, radius 4, inset 1px borderColor-default.
4 Time: 12/22, 600, fgColor-muted, tabular-nums. Pinned right, never shrinks.
5 Status glyph: 16x16 at x 32, centred on line 2. Colour per legend.
6 Sentence: 13/20, 400, fgColor-muted, x 56, ellipsis at its end.
8 Author: 14px PersonIcon, 4 gap, login. Drops first when line 3 overflows.
9 Files: 14px FileIcon, 4 gap, count. Drops after the repo name reaches 64px.
10 Diff size: 12/20 muted, "+a -d". Pinned right, never shrinks.
11 Comments: 14px BubbleIcon, 4 gap, count. Pinned right. Hidden at 0.
Line gaps 6 (--gap-row-lines); row padding 12 (--row-pad-y) top and bottom.
Line 3 item gap 12. Right group starts 12 after the left group at the least.
